description: This is the main server implementation for the Battle for Wesnoth game, handling network connections, player login, game creation/joining, command processing, and server management.

classes.name: server
classes.description: Main server class managing player connections, game sessions, and command processing.

methods.name: server::server
methods.description: Constructor initializing server with port, input stream, configuration, and thread count.

methods.name: server::run
methods.description: Main server loop accepting connections, processing data, and managing server state.

methods.name: server::process_data
methods.description: Handles incoming data from clients, routing to login, lobby, or game processing.

methods.name: server::process_login
methods.description: Processes login requests, validates username, and manages player state.

methods.name: server::process_query
methods.description: Handles server queries such as metrics and admin commands.

methods.name: server::process_data_from_player_in_lobby
methods.description: Handles lobby interactions like creating or joining games, messaging.

methods.name: server::process_data_from_player_in_game
methods.description: Processes in-game commands, game state updates, player bans/kicks, and game lifecycle.

methods.name: server::delete_game
methods.description: Removes a game from server state and updates configuration.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point initializing server parameters, parsing command-line options, and starting server.
